Hospital Name: Lakeside General Hospital
Department: Gastroenterology
Patient Name: Robert Miller
MRN: RM4567890
DOB: 07/22/1965
Age: 59
Sex: Male
Encounter Date: 10/26/2024
Document Type: Endoscopy Report
Provider: Dr. David Lee, MD

Preoperative Diagnosis: Chronic diarrhea, abdominal pain, rule out inflammatory bowel disease.
Postoperative Diagnosis: Chronic diarrhea, abdominal pain, mild diverticulosis, colonic inflammation.
Procedure Performed: Colonoscopy, flexible, diagnostic, with collection of specimen(s) by brushing or washing.
Primary Surgeon: Dr. David Lee, MD
Anesthesia Type: Moderate Sedation (Fentanyl and Midazolam)

Indications for Procedure: Patient presents with a 6-month history of intermittent chronic diarrhea, occasional abdominal cramping, and unexplained weight loss. Previous stool studies were negative. Colonoscopy is indicated to evaluate for inflammatory bowel disease, polyps, or other colonic pathology.

Description of Procedure:
After obtaining informed consent, the patient was placed in the left lateral decubitus position. Moderate sedation was administered. Digital rectal exam was performed, revealing no masses. The colonoscope (Olympus CF-HQ190) was advanced smoothly through the anus, rectum, sigmoid colon, descending colon, transverse colon, ascending colon, and into the cecum. The terminal ileum was intubated for approximately 5 cm. The entire colon was carefully inspected during withdrawal.

Findings:
RECTUM: Normal mucosa.
SIGMOID COLON: Mild diverticulosis noted, no signs of diverticulitis. Mucosa otherwise unremarkable.
DESCENDING COLON: Scattered areas of mild erythema and granularity. Brushings were taken from these areas for cytology.
TRANSVERSE COLON: Normal mucosa.
ASCENDING COLON: Normal mucosa.
CECUM: Normal mucosa. Appendiceal orifice visualized.
TERMINAL ILEUM: Normal mucosa.

Specimens: Brushings from descending colon (sent for cytology).
Complications: None.
Disposition: Patient tolerated the procedure well and was transferred to recovery in stable condition. Discharged home with instructions.

Electronically Signed By:
Dr. David Lee, MD
Gastroenterologist

Date Signed: 10/26/2024 15:10

End of Report
